denominators._note: The subtraction ran over the WHOLE carried population, not the carded list alone. Both groups fall entirely inside `carded`: that is a MEASURED result here, not the domain assumed at the start.

re_identification_instrument.two_carrier: '{system}' in canonical AND '{cadence}' in canonical -- INDEPENDENT of round 6's CADENCE_PLUS_SYSTEM label, which is not read anywhere in this record's derivation. Agreement with the declared 51 is the corroboration.
re_identification_instrument.unsanctioned_brace: the row's own brace tokens MINUS the four NAMING_SCHEMA.json grade.placeholder sanctions ({system}, {source}, {scope}, {cadence}); a non-empty remainder is an unsanctioned brace. Written as a subtraction from a printed denominator, never as a forward list of tokens recalled (Rule 24 i).
re_identification_instrument.cadence_carrier: measured per row from the repo's Terraform: brace-balanced aws_cloudwatch_event_rule blocks, literal `name` field, presence of schedule_expression vs event_pattern; for a LOG_GROUP, the aws_cloudwatch_event_target edge that points a rule at the group.
measured_limits_of_that_scan: It matches a LITERAL `name = "..."`; a rule whose name is interpolated is invisible to it, so NOT-FOUND means 'no literal-name declaration', never 'not declared'. Those rows carry carrier_kind LIVE_RULE_NO_REPO_DECLARATION, which names a carrier that exists either way.

The firing attribute is read as an ATTRIBUTE after comment lines are stripped, never as a substring -- MEASURED BY BEING WRONG FIRST: a substring test reported aws_cloudwatch_event_rule.exec_summary_trigger_placeholder (infra/aws/terraform/exec-summary/main.tf) as carrying BOTH expressions, because the block's COMMENT at :225 names event_pattern as future work. The block declares schedule_expression only. A classifier that reads PROSE ABOUT an attribute as the attribute names a carrier the world does not have.

label_definition: TWO_CARRIER_PLACEHOLDER_ROW -- a carded row whose canonical form carries BOTH {system} and {cadence}, so the name is cleared only by values from TWO DIFFERENT CARRIERS and NEITHER REMEDY ALONE clears it: taking one leaves a brace in the name and records a resolution that is not one. CARRIER 1, the {system} half: infra/logic/registry/resources.json -- the resource-to-system row keyed (name, type), read at lib/opal_naming.py:1030-1032. IN a cell's grant; the act is to MINT that row, its system read from the Terraform ROOT that declares the resource and checked against infra/logic/registry/systems.json, cited as the row's evidence. CARRIER 2, the {cadence} half: the RULE'S OWN EXPRESSION, and WHICH expression is a measured property of the row, not a constant -- schedule_expression mapped onto NAMING_SCHEMA.json cadence.values (daily|weekly|monthly|hourly), or event_pattern mapped onto cadence.event_form 'on-{event}'. NOT in that grant. For a LOG_GROUP the carrier is not the group at all: it is the rule that TARGETS the group, reached through aws_cloudwatch_event_target. MECHANICAL TEST a later census runs with no judgment and no owner's opinion: '{system}' in canonical AND '{cadence}' in canonical. PER ROW, remedies[].carrier names WHERE the value comes from (file and declaration, or the read-only live call), remedies[].act names WHAT TO DO with it, and remedies[].in_a_cells_grant says whether a worker could take it inside the round-6 grant. A row leaves this label only when BOTH acts are taken; a census that takes one and re-labels the row has re-created the defect this label exists to end.

the_label_this_replaces.why_it_lied: It is a ONE-REMEDY label ('the token is not a system'), and 51 of the rows filed under it need TWO carriers. A row needing two remedies filed under a one-remedy label is INVISIBLE TO BOTH: the seat holding the registry grant sees a row it cannot finish, the seat holding the schedule read sees the same, and neither is wrong. Rule 24 INTENT COHERENCE failing inside the campaign built to enumerate.
the_label_this_replaces.note_on_the_name: The 15 key-template rows carried the SAME class name for a different and also false reason, which is why one label repair covers two groups.
